title.narrative: Training and Operational Partnership against Organised Crime (TOPCOP) II

description.narrative:
The project¿s overall objective is to reduce organised crime across the Eastern Partnership countries.

The specific objective is represented by increased effectiveness of joint response mechanisms between EaP and EU MSs law enforcement authorities in investigating and combating organised crime and criminal threats.

Through their respective mandates, CEPOL and Europol aim to promote police cooperation and information exchange and develop effective tools to prevent and fight organised crime. In this regard, both Agencies aim to foster effective criminal investigations on organised crime.
